researcher.sentenceEn: Researchers think the zoo was started with animals brought home from a far-off land known as Punt.
researcher.translationZh: 研究人员认为，这座动物园最初是用从一个名为“蓬特”的遥远国度带回的动物建立的。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

researcher.sentenceEn: Researchers don't think language was invented; instead, they think it evolved.
researcher.translationZh: 研究人员认为语言并非人为发明，而是逐渐进化而来的。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

researcher.sentenceEn: Modesty may be key when cooperation is essential, but the researchers also found that in some cases, status signaling has advantages.
researcher.translationZh: 在合作至关重要的情况下，谦逊或许是关键，但研究人员也发现，在某些情况下，彰显地位会更具优势。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

researcher.sentenceEn: The researchers put forth policy contributions, ranging from sustainable disposal of leftover stock to production tax to incentivize both manufacturers and consumers to be more waste conscious.
researcher.translationZh: 研究人员提出了多项政策建议，包括可持续处理库存积压产品和征收生产税，以激励制造商和消费者提高浪费意识。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

researcher.sentenceEn: In Egypt, researchers have found buildings from around 3500 B.C., containing the remains of animals, including elephants, which were not native to Egypt.
researcher.translationZh: 在埃及，研究人员发现了约公元前3500年的建筑，其中包含动物遗骸，包括并非埃及本土物种的大象。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

researcher.sentenceEn: Why did the researchers put forth such policies as production tax?
researcher.translationZh: 为什么研究人员提出了诸如生产税这样的政策？

reduce.sentenceEn: Environmentalists have long believed that building roads or homes near the bears may threaten their survival by " reducing or fragmenting their natural: habitats", The Times reported.
reduce.translationZh: 《泰晤士报》报道，环保人士长期以来认为，在熊类栖息地附近修建道路或房屋可能会通过“减少或分割它们的自然栖息地”来威胁其生存。
reduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

reduce.sentenceEn: In an extensive study published in 2015, researchers analyzed a total of 99 choice studies and specifically looked at those cases in which reducing choices helped to boost sales.
reduce.translationZh: 在2015年发表的一项广泛研究中，研究人员分析了总共99项选择研究，并特别关注了减少选择有助于提高销售额的那些案例。
reduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

reduce.sentenceEn: "It's also about reducing the amount of grain carbs(碳水化合物) and protein and fats in our diet, and increasing fibre."
reduce.translationZh: 这还关乎减少饮食中谷物碳水化合物、蛋白质和脂肪的摄入量，同时增加纤维的摄入。

reduce.sentenceEn: But until those systems become standard, human drivers can help reduce phantom traffic jams simply by not following the car in front so closely.
reduce.translationZh: 但在这些系统成为标准配置之前，人类驾驶员只需与前车保持足够车距，就能帮助减少幽灵堵车的发生。

reduce.sentenceEn: A lot of research has demonstrated that drinking fruit juice does not reduce our daily consumption of other foods.
reduce.translationZh: 大量研究表明，饮用果汁并不会减少我们日常对其他食物的摄入量。

reduce.sentenceEn: It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.
reduce.translationZh: 它能降低因肉类消费带来的各种健康风险。

relationship.sentenceEn: "It may well be that the messy nature of their relationship with human efforts induces more animals to scatter or travel further, and might result in greater genetic connectivity and enhanced population persistence."
relationship.translationZh: 很可能是由于它们与人类活动之间这种复杂混乱的关系，促使更多动物四散迁徙或前往更远的地方，这或许会增强基因连通性并提高种群的存续能力。
relationship.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

relationship.sentenceEn: Another study found a relationship between fruit juice and type 2 diabetes after following the diets and diabetes status of more than 70,000 nurses over 18 years.
relationship.translationZh: 另一项研究对7万多名护士进行了18年的饮食和糖尿病状况追踪，发现果汁与2型糖尿病之间存在关联。

relationship.sentenceEn: Overall, the new study found no significant relationship between participants' month of birth and symptoms of depression or anxiety.
relationship.translationZh: 总体而言，这项新研究发现参与者的出生月份与抑郁或焦虑症状之间没有显著关联。
relationship.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

relationship.sentenceEn: Another theory Friedman considers is that, in an era of ever fewer settings that provide effective opportunities for personal connections and relationships , people may place more value on the socializing that happens at work.
relationship.translationZh: 弗里德曼考虑的另一种理论是，在一个能提供有效人际交往和建立关系机会的环境越来越少的时代，人们可能会更加重视在工作中发生的社交活动。

relationship.sentenceEn: What did the new study find about the relationship between participants' month of birth and symptoms of depression?
relationship.translationZh: 这项新研究关于参与者的出生月份与抑郁症状之间的关系有何发现？

relationship.sentenceEn: They attach more value to their relationships with others.
relationship.translationZh: 他们更重视与他人的关系。

risk.sentenceEn: New research suggests that pandas may be at risk of dying out because they are too comfortable.
risk.translationZh: 新研究表明，大熊猫可能因生活过于安逸而面临灭绝风险。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

risk.sentenceEn: But we have a higher risk of consuming more than the recommended daily number of calories (around 2,000 for women and 2,500 for men) on the days we drink juice, according to research.
risk.translationZh: 但研究显示，在饮用果汁的日子里，我们摄入的卡路里更有可能超过每日推荐摄入量（女性约2000卡，男性约2500卡）。

risk.sentenceEn: Over time, this mechanism can wear out, increasing the risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
risk.translationZh: 随着时间的推移，这种机制可能会逐渐失效，从而增加患2型糖尿病的风险。

risk.sentenceEn: But when they do lead to too many calories, they risk raising blood sugar and insulin levels.
risk.translationZh: 但当它们确实导致摄入过多热量时，就可能会升高血糖和胰岛素水平。

risk.sentenceEn: Diets containing large amounts of fibre reduce the risk of heart disease, diabetes and other health hazards.
risk.translationZh: 富含大量纤维的饮食可降低患心脏病、糖尿病和其他健康风险的几率。

risk.sentenceEn: It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.
risk.translationZh: 它能降低因肉类消费带来的各种健康风险。

rate.sentenceEn: From our experience so far, flexible seating enhances student ownership of space and engagement in learning, while reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary actions.
rate.translationZh: 根据我们目前的经验，灵活的座位安排增强了学生对空间的主人翁意识和学习参与度，同时也降低了学生消极参与和违纪行为的发生率。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

rate.sentenceEn: But recent studies show a lack of exercise is not to blame for rising obesity rates .
rate.translationZh: 但近期的研究表明，运动不足并非导致肥胖率上升的原因。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

rate.sentenceEn: The teenagers also rated healthy eating as being more appealing.
rate.translationZh: 青少年们也认为健康饮食更具吸引力。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

rate.sentenceEn: They rate the post-45 job seekers lower on average on all three measures — even experience — than those ages 18 to 34.
rate.translationZh: 对于 45 岁以上的求职者，他们在所有三项衡量标准（甚至包括经验）上的平均评分都低于 18 至 34 岁的求职者。

rate.sentenceEn: Judging from the slowing rate of sales growth, there is still hope to combat bottled water.
rate.translationZh: 从销售增速放缓来看，对抗瓶装水仍有希望。

rate.sentenceEn: The rate of wage increase in terms of purchasing power has slowed down for years.
rate.translationZh: 以购买力衡量的工资增长率已持续多年放缓。

resident.sentenceEn: When Janette Sadik-Khan was the head of New York City's Transportation Department back in the early 2000s, she oversaw a rollout(推出) of bike lanes — and got angry blowback from residents and business owners who claimed there weren't enough cyclists to justify installing lanes.
resident.translationZh: 21世纪初，珍妮特·萨迪克-汗（Janette Sadik-Khan）担任纽约市交通局局长时，曾主持推广自行车道。当时，此举遭到了当地居民和企业主的强烈反对，他们声称骑行者人数太少，根本不值得安装自行车道。

resident.sentenceEn: The skin was found at a construction site, and the government wrote to residents to warn them.
resident.translationZh: 在一家施工现场发现了蛇皮，政府已致信居民发出警告。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

resident.sentenceEn: Due to smoke and heat damage, the four apartments were declared uninhabitable, and the six residents had to move to another place, officials said.
resident.translationZh: 官员表示，由于烟熏和热力损坏，这四套公寓已被宣布不适宜居住，六名居民不得不迁居他处。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

resident.sentenceEn: At any rate, what was lost has now been found by many of the community's littlest residents .
resident.translationZh: 无论如何，那些遗失的物品现在已经被社区里的许多小居民们找到了。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

resident.sentenceEn: Why did the six residents have to find another place to stay?
resident.translationZh: 为什么这六位居民必须另找地方居住？

resident.sentenceEn: It is strongly opposed by nearby residents .
resident.translationZh: 遭到附近居民的强烈反对。

reward.sentenceEn: However, if you work on sticking to those small positive habits one day at a time, it becomes easier to stay strong and achieve that delayed reward .
reward.translationZh: 然而，如果你坚持每天培养这些微小的积极习惯，就会更容易保持毅力并最终获得那份延迟的回报。
reward.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

reward.sentenceEn: Instead of fighting your present self's need for immediate rewards , why not use it to your advantage?
reward.translationZh: 与其抗拒当下的自己对即时回报的需求，何不将其为你所用呢？

reward.sentenceEn: Once a reward is achieved, it is much easier to continue sticking to your habits.
reward.translationZh: 一旦获得了回报，就更容易继续坚持你的习惯了。
reward.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

reward.sentenceEn: Our guest today is John Banks, the author of the best selling new book, Rewarding Success.
reward.translationZh: 我们今天的嘉宾是约翰·班克斯，他是畅销书《奖励成功》的作者。
reward.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

reward.sentenceEn: What will be one option for funding the proposed rewards according to the man?
reward.translationZh: 根据这位男士的说法，为拟议的奖励提供资金的一个选择是什么？

reward.sentenceEn: We may not get immediate rewards from self-control.
reward.translationZh: 我们可能无法立即从自我控制中获得回报。

responsibility.sentenceEn: "I think luxury companies have a real role to play and a responsibility ," says Humm.
responsibility.translationZh: “我认为奢侈品公司确实应当发挥作用，并承担起相应的责任，”胡姆（Humm）说道。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

responsibility.sentenceEn: They have been attracted by a patch of land this close to wilderness, and it is their responsibility to keep it that way.
responsibility.translationZh: 他们被这片如此靠近荒野的土地所吸引，而保持它的原始状态正是他们的责任。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

responsibility.sentenceEn: Women also talked about family caregiving responsibilities .
responsibility.translationZh: 女性们也谈到了家庭照料责任。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

responsibility.sentenceEn: A retired vice president from a major chemical company stated, "Young women engineers are on an equal footing until they have children, then they struggle to balance work and family—and compete with men who don't have the same household responsibilities ."
responsibility.translationZh: 一家大型化工公司的退休副总裁表示：“年轻女性工程师在生育前与男性处于平等地位，但有了孩子后，她们就要艰难地平衡工作与家庭，还要和那些没有同等家庭责任的男性竞争。”
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

responsibility.sentenceEn: A household pet can also cultivate a child's sense of responsibility as their parent explains the necessary processes of keeping their pet happy and healthy.
responsibility.translationZh: 当父母向孩子解释如何让宠物保持快乐健康的必要过程时，家庭宠物也能培养孩子的责任感。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

responsibility.sentenceEn: It emphasizes people's sense of social responsibility .
responsibility.translationZh: 它强调了人们的社会责任感。

resource.sentenceEn: But if you prefer Civilization, Total War, or X-Com, where strategy and resource management are key, then you might have more in common with managers.
resource.translationZh: 但如果你更倾向于《文明》、《全面战争》或《幽浮》这类将战略与资源管理视为核心的游戏，那么你可能与管理者们有更多共同语言。

resource.sentenceEn: "We see gameplay as a resource of talent," says co-founder David Barrie.
resource.translationZh: 联合创始人戴维·巴里表示：“我们视游戏玩法为一种人才资源。”

resource.sentenceEn: Earth Day is an annual celebration that honors the achievements of the environmental movement and raises awareness of the need to protect Earth's natural resources for future generations.
resource.translationZh: 世界地球日是一项年度纪念活动，旨在赞颂环保运动所取得的成就，并提高人们保护地球自然资源以造福子孙后代的意识。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

resource.sentenceEn: M: Well, if people have smaller homes, they use less land and fewer resources to build them.
resource.translationZh: 男士：嗯，如果人们住的房子更小，他们建造房子时就会使用更少的土地和资源。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第1句

resource.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about countries lacking in medical resources ?
resource.translationZh: 这篇文章关于医疗资源匮乏的国家说了什么？

resource.sentenceEn: They can do research with limited resources .
resource.translationZh: 他们能用有限的资源进行研究。

realize.sentenceEn: That's why brain scientist Richard Kennedy says "It's not that old dogs can't learn new tricks. It's that maybe old dogs don't realize why they should."
realize.translationZh: 这就是为什么脑科学家理查德·肯尼迪说：“并不是老狗学不会新把戏，而是老狗可能没意识到为什么要学。”
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

realize.sentenceEn: Ford asks us to question unconscious beliefs, to realize that we almost never do so, to understand that the simplest choices are charged with meaning, and yet that meaning can and does change all the time.
realize.translationZh: 福特要求我们审视那些无意识的信念，认识到我们几乎从未这样做过，理解最简单的选择都承载着意义，而这种意义能够并且确实在不断变化。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

realize.sentenceEn: The army officers heard a noise coming from the well and realized an elephant was trapped deep inside.
realize.translationZh: 军官们听到井里传来声响，意识到有一头大象被困在深井里。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

realize.sentenceEn: What I'm starting to realize , however, is that new knowledge does not necessarily drive new results.
realize.translationZh: 然而，我开始意识到，新知识并不一定能带来新成果。

realize.sentenceEn: What does the WFP's winning of the Nobel Peace Prize make us realize ?
realize.translationZh: 世界粮食计划署获得诺贝尔和平奖让我们意识到什么？

recently.sentenceEn: Recently , the clothing industry has come under attack for creating a waste problem with serious environmental consequences.
recently.translationZh: 最近，服装行业因造成具有严重环境后果的浪费问题而受到抨击。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

recently.sentenceEn: He has recently been commissioned to design the new Museum of London building in Smithfield.
recently.translationZh: 他最近受委托设计位于史密斯菲尔德的新伦敦博物馆大楼。

recently.sentenceEn: Recently , a leading design federation in the UK warned that the UK could face a creative skills shortage, after the latest figures revealed a drop of almost 10 percent in students studying Design and Technology.
recently.translationZh: 近日，英国一家领先的设计联合会发出警告，称英国可能面临创意技能短缺问题。最新数据显示，学习设计与技术专业的学生人数下降了近10%。

recently.sentenceEn: Even so, there have been a very small number of cases recently when authorities discovered eggs during further inspections.
recently.translationZh: 即便如此，最近仍有极少数案例显示，有关部门在进一步检查中发现了虫卵。

recently.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the man's book published recently ?
recently.translationZh: 关于这位男士最近出版的书，我们了解到什么？

recently.translationZh: 此处最近已发生数起致命事故。

replace.sentenceEn: This reduced self-threat could even be observed when participants assumed that they were being replaced by other employees who relied on technological abilities such as artificial intelligence in their work.
replace.translationZh: 即使当参与者认为自己正被那些在工作中依赖人工智能等技术能力的其他员工所取代时，这种自我威胁感的降低依然可以被观察到。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

replace.sentenceEn: Despite intensive academic debate on these developments, there has been little study on how workers react to being replaced through technology.
replace.translationZh: 尽管学术界对这些发展进行了深入辩论，但关于劳动者如何应对技术替代的研究却寥寥无几。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

replace.sentenceEn: The findings show: In principle, most people view it more favorably when workers are replaced by other people than by robots or intelligent software.
replace.translationZh: 研究结果表明：原则上，大多数人更倾向于接受工人被其他人取代，而非被机器人或智能软件取代。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

replace.sentenceEn: Consequently, being replaced by a robot or software poses less of a threat to their feeling of self-worth.
replace.translationZh: 因此，被机器人或软件取代对他们的自我价值感威胁较小。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

replace.sentenceEn: Local business owners on Skillman Ave argued that their businesses would be ruined when parking spots were replaced by bike lanes.

response.sentenceEn: The most common question I'm asked always centers around how to get started in user experience design, to which my response is always that nothing can substitute real-world experience.
response.translationZh: 我最常被问到的问题总是围绕着如何入行用户体验设计，而我的回答也始终如一：没有什么能替代实战经验。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

response.sentenceEn: If you're especially into a piece of music, your brain does something called Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response (ASMR), which feels to you like a sting in your brain.
response.translationZh: 如果你特别沉浸于某首乐曲，你的大脑会产生一种被称为“自发性知觉经络反应”（ASMR）的现象，这让你感觉大脑中有一种酥麻的刺痛感。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

response.sentenceEn: But it may also be an expression of a desire for going outdoors—a response to the months of lockdown.
response.translationZh: 但这也可能是渴望户外活动的一种表达——是对长达数月封锁的一种反应。

response.sentenceEn: But after a time, your fear response to other things in life will be dramatically reduced.
response.translationZh: 但经过一段时间后，你对生活中其他事物的恐惧反应将会显著减少。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

response.sentenceEn: What do supporters say in response to the restaurant's new policy?
response.translationZh: 支持者对餐厅的新政策有何反应？

response.sentenceEn: It might prompt different responses from people of different social backgrounds.
response.translationZh: 这可能会引发不同社会背景的人产生不同的反应。

remove.sentenceEn: Another reason for fruit juice's recent popularity is the argument that it can help to remove poisonous or harmful substances from the body.
remove.translationZh: 果汁近来受欢迎的另一个原因是有人认为它有助于清除体内的有毒或有害物质。

remove.sentenceEn: Unlike whole fruit, fruit juice has most of the fibre removed .
remove.translationZh: 与完整水果不同，果汁中的大部分纤维已被去除。

remove.translationZh: 然而，克莱门斯说：“果汁饮食有助于清除体内有毒或有害物质的整个概念是完全错误的。”

remove.sentenceEn: "We consume compounds every day that may be poisonous and our bodies do a wonderful job of removing and eliminating anything harmful from our bodies."
remove.translationZh: 我们每天都会摄入一些可能有毒的化合物，而我们的身体在清除和排出体内有害物质方面做得非常出色。

remove.sentenceEn: Why did Daniel Humm decide to remove meat from the menu of his restaurant?
remove.translationZh: 为什么丹尼尔·赫姆（Daniel Humm）决定从他的餐厅菜单中去掉肉类？

remove.sentenceEn: Help remove pandas from the list of endangered species.

reasoning.sentenceEn: Logical learners have a linear mind and would rather use logic, reasoning and systems.

recover.sentenceEn: Investigators were also able to recover the key that was used to open the collection boxes.

recycle.translationZh: 为什么男士说每个人都应该努力进行回收？

reputation.sentenceEn: Five-year-olds aren't just aware of their reputations , they also behave strategically to alter their outward image.

reputation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

reputation.sentenceEn: Interactive experiences may provide opportunities for children to learn about what constitutes a desirable reputation and the kinds of strategies that are effective for building a good reputation in their social environment.

reputation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

reputation.sentenceEn: They have a reputation of being overly strict with the students, not to mention the overwhelming amount of homework they assign, which would lead to a lot of pressure for Jake and me.

route.sentenceEn: The service, which claims to be the first of its kind in India, offers only one route , but Bangalore airport will add more once it gets approval.
route.translationZh: 这项号称印度首个此类服务目前仅提供一条航线，但班加罗尔机场在获得批准后将增加更多航线。

restriction.sentenceEn: Ford's thesis is that the best way to understand what particular fashions meant in any given era is to look at the restrictions placed on them.

restriction.sentenceEn: Data connecting excessive digital media time to mental health issues suggests a limit of two hours a day of free time spent with screens, a restriction that will also allow time for other activities—like going to the movies with friends or reading longer, more complicated texts.

restriction.sentenceEn: W: So I think it's the restrictions that create the dangers sometimes.
restriction.translationZh: 所以我认为有时候恰恰是这些限制措施制造了危险。

ruin.sentenceEn: And then, you just end up ruining the book for yourself, if the show isn't very good.

redesign.sentenceEn: People may find it more pleasant to wander around streets redesigned for cycling and walking.

renovate.translationZh: 在人的一生中，大脑会不断自我更新。
renovate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

renovate.sentenceEn: After an American company, Liberty Media, acquired the Formula One competition recently, Chase Carey—a former executive with Fox Broadcasting Company and DirecTV who by his own admission is not a fierce racing fan—was named to replace Ecclestone and to try to renovate the organization's management, reach and ambition.
renovate.translationZh: 近日，美国公司自由媒体集团(Liberty Media)收购了一级方程式赛车赛事。此后，蔡斯·凯里(Chase Carey)被任命接替埃克莱斯顿，负责改革该组织的管理模式、扩大其影响力并提升其发展愿景。凯里曾是福克斯广播公司(Fox Broadcasting Company)和直播电视公司(DirectTV)的高管，他坦言自己并非狂热的赛车迷。

renovate.sentenceEn: Jonathan and I are thinking of renovating our sitting room, not the whole house, not yet anyway.
renovate.translationZh: 乔纳森和我正考虑翻新我们的客厅，不是整个房子，至少现在还不打算。
renovate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

renovate.sentenceEn: Starting April 28th of this year, the National Museum of Natural History will begin renovating its fossil hall.
renovate.translationZh: 从今年4月28日开始，美国国家自然历史博物馆将对其化石展厅进行翻新。
renovate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

renovate.sentenceEn: Desiring new experiences can help to renovate the brain.
renovate.translationZh: 渴望新体验有助于大脑更新。

repeatedly.sentenceEn: It's great to stay fit and healthy, but standard exercise routines and sports only work the same muscles repeatedly .
repeatedly.translationZh: 保持身体健康固然很好，但标准的锻炼计划和运动只会重复锻炼相同的肌肉群。
repeatedly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

repeatedly.sentenceEn: When we use the same praise repeatedly , it may become empty and no longer valued by the child.
repeatedly.translationZh: 当我们反复使用同样的表扬时，它可能会变得空洞，不再被孩子重视。
repeatedly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

repeatedly.sentenceEn: Children were split into three groups, with one group asked to try the bowl of carrots repeatedly with no further encouragement.
repeatedly.translationZh: 孩子们被分为三组，其中一组被要求反复食用这碗胡萝卜，没有额外的鼓励。
repeatedly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

repeatedly.sentenceEn: A snowmobile driver had repeatedly attempted to harm her and her team, and one of Zirkle's dogs had received a non-life-threatening injury.
repeatedly.translationZh: 一名雪地摩托驾驶员多次试图伤害她和她的团队，其中一只泽克尔的雪橇犬受了伤，但伤势并不危及生命。
repeatedly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

repeatedly.sentenceEn: Whitman repeatedly reworked "Song of Myself" between 1855 and 1891.
repeatedly.translationZh: 惠特曼在1855年至1891年间反复修改《自我之歌》。

repeatedly.sentenceEn: A writer should polish his writing repeatedly so as to get closer to perfection.
repeatedly.translationZh: 作家应反复打磨自己的作品，以臻于完美。

risky.sentenceEn: At the time, Humm acknowledged the move was risky , admitting that "it wasn't clear if guests would come", but called the gamble "a risk worth taking."
risky.translationZh: 当时，胡姆承认这一举动具有风险，坦言“不确定客人们是否会买账”，但他称这场豪赌是“值得一试的风险”。
risky.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

risky.sentenceEn: W: That sounds risky to me.
risky.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

risky.sentenceEn: "Depending on a greater number of plant species creates a more vigorous and less risky food system—and one that provides a broader range of nutritional requirements."
risky.translationZh: 依赖更多种类的植物物种能够构建一个更具活力且风险更低的食物系统——同时也能提供更广泛的营养需求。

risky.sentenceEn: According to Barabasi, it's easier and less risky for those in positions of power to choose to hand awards and funding to those who've already been so recognized.
risky.translationZh: 巴拉巴西认为，对于掌权者而言，将奖项和资金授予那些已经获得认可的人，既更简单也风险更低。
这不应该被视为冒险之举。

roast.sentenceEn: The effect would be to roast the beans all over, and produce perfect coffee.
roast.translationZh: 这样做的效果是咖啡豆能够全方位均匀受热，从而烘焙出完美的咖啡。
roast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

roast.sentenceEn: But if gravity is removed, the beans float around in a heated oven, receiving 360 degrees of evenly distributed heat and roast to near perfection.
roast.translationZh: 但如果去除重力，咖啡豆会在加热的容器中漂浮，接受360度均匀分布的热量，烤至近乎完美。
roast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

roast.sentenceEn: A pair of entrepreneurs are planning to build and launch a spacecraft that would carry and roast coffee beans in outer space.
roast.translationZh: 两位企业家正计划建造并发射一艘航天器，用于在太空中携带和烘焙咖啡豆。
roast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

roast.sentenceEn: The beans would then be roasted in the heat generated by the craft's 20-minute re-entry into Earth's atmosphere.
roast.translationZh: 随后，咖啡豆将在航天器重返地球大气层的20分钟过程中所产生的热量中进行烘焙。
roast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

roast.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about coffee beans roasted on Earth?
roast.translationZh: 文章中关于在地球上烘焙的咖啡豆说了什么？

roast.sentenceEn: They abandoned the attempt to roast coffee beans in space.
roast.translationZh: 他们放弃了在太空中烘焙咖啡豆的尝试。

routinely.sentenceEn: The unusual situation started about 12 months ago, when one cat routinely started visiting the store.
routinely.translationZh: 这种不寻常的情况大约始于12个月前，当时有一只猫开始定期光顾这家商店。
routinely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

routinely.sentenceEn: Online purchases are routinely followed up by a customer satisfaction survey.
routinely.translationZh: 网上购物后，通常会有一份顾客满意度调查跟进。
routinely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

routinely.sentenceEn: For example, Americans routinely overestimate the share of black recipients of public assistance programs.
routinely.translationZh: 例如，美国人通常会高估黑人接受公共援助项目的比例。

routinely.sentenceEn: Recruitment advertisements routinely call for "team players".
routinely.translationZh: 招聘广告中通常会要求应聘者为“团队合作者”。

routinely.sentenceEn: Loosely managed teams can become hotbeds of distraction―employees routinely complain that they can't get their work done because they are forced to spend too much time in meetings or compelled to work in noisy offices.
routinely.translationZh: 管理松散的团队可能会成为注意力分散的温床——员工经常抱怨他们无法完成工作，因为他们被迫花费太多时间参加会议，或者不得不在嘈杂的办公室里工作。

routinely.sentenceEn: What did some customers think when they saw the first cat routinely appear in the store?
routinely.translationZh: 当一些顾客看到第一只猫开始经常出现在店里时，他们是怎么想的？

rural.sentenceEn: Most Africans live in rural areas that are tough to wire for Internet access.
rural.translationZh: 大多数非洲人生活在农村地区，这些地区难以铺设互联网线路。
rural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

rural.sentenceEn: People living in rural areas, however, lag behind in online use, which limits their access to government services, banking and job opportunities.
rural.translationZh: 然而，农村地区居民在互联网使用方面却落后了，这限制了他们获取政府服务、银行服务和就业机会的途径。
rural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

rural.sentenceEn: When I think of motorsports in the U.S., what we all think of is Nascar, and the narrative of Nascar is sort of rural , white, working-class Americans, mostly in the South, connecting with the atmosphere of those races.
rural.translationZh: 当我想到美国的赛车运动时，我们首先想到的都是纳斯卡车赛。纳斯卡车赛的故事叙事，在某种程度上代表着美国南部乡村地区的白人工人阶级，他们与这些赛事的氛围紧密相连。

rural.sentenceEn: It's Ken Outlaw, a welder in rural North Carolina whose dream of going back to school at a local community college was dashed by Hurricane Florence—just one of the extreme weather events that have tipped the balance for struggling Americans across the nation.
rural.translationZh: 比如肯·奥特洛，这位北卡罗来纳州农村的焊工，他重返当地社区大学深造的梦想被佛罗伦萨飓风无情击碎——这只是众多极端天气事件之一，这些事件让全美各地本已举步维艰的美国人雪上加霜。

rural.sentenceEn: While there were neighborhood schools in cities and suburbs, one-room schoolhouses were common in rural areas.
rural.translationZh: 虽然城市和郊区已有社区学校，但单间校舍在农村地区十分常见。

rural.sentenceEn: Rural kids used to walk a long way to school in the old days.
rural.translationZh: 过去，农村孩子常常要走很长的路去上学。
